content: We need a retrosynthesis route with 1 reaction to produce target molecule. The hint describes carbonyl-ene reaction forward: carbonyl + alkene -> product with new C-C bond, C=O to C-O, C=C to C-C, forming aliphatic hydroxyl and five-membered ring. So retrosynthesis: break that product back to a carbonyl (ketone) and an alkene that undergoes ene reaction to give the product. So we need to find a template that corresponds to carbonyl-ene reaction (retro). Search for templates where retro_smarts maybe shows [C:...]-[OH] to carbonyl etc. Let's search for functional groups broken: aliphatic hydroxyls and five-membered rings (product) to ketone and C=C (reactants). Use search with functional_groups_broken = ["aliphatic hydroxyls","five-membered rings"], functional_groups_formed = ["ketones","C-C double bonds"] maybe.
